data_gaps: Google web search (google.com/search) returned a 'unusual traffic' CAPTCHA for this IP, so nothing was verified through Google result pages; individual Google Maps place pages did load and were used instead.

Google Maps was served in the limited (signed-out) view, which shows the star rating but not the review count. Review counts for Vitality Staffing, Optical Boutique, Brunswick's Finest, Miguel's Painting, Park Chiropractic and Ralph's come from Birdeye/BestProsInTown mirrors, not from Google directly.

The same limited Maps view shows an 'Add photos & videos' prompt on every profile, including ones that clearly have photos, so it cannot be used to prove a profile has zero photos (affects the Miguel's Painting and Ralph's photo claims).

Mobile layout was tested with a CDP device-metrics override at 390 px CSS width; the tool's mobile=true override did not apply, so behaviour observed is responsive CSS at 390 px rather than an emulated phone with a mobile user agent.
salondiscover.com returned HTTP 403, so the '9am-8pm seven days' hours for Brunswick's Finest were verified at bestprosintown.com instead.
No form, booking or quote flow was submitted anywhere (read-only); 'working' or 'broken' judgements on forms are based on rendered markup, field labels and action/method only.
